_purpose: Canonical registry of which LLMs DWS subscription products should run on. The weekly task scripts/weekly/llm-currency-check.sh lints src/agents/* against this file and flags drift (deprecated/suspended models still in use, and candidates not yet adopted). Updating 'what is current' is a data edit here — not a code change. See docs/LLM_UPDATE_TASK.md for the full explanation and procedure.

statuses.candidate: Newly available — evaluate for adoption (not yet a hard requirement).
statuses.deprecated: Still callable but scheduled for removal — migrate to 'replacement'.
statuses.suspended: Temporarily unavailable (provider/export-control) — must NOT be a hard dependency; needs a fallback.
statuses.retired: No longer available — calls will error.
